content.headline: Automate Non-Coding Work with AI Agents
content.subheadline: Reclaiming developer time with Canva MCP.
body_points: Automated Documentation: Generate API specs and READMEs directly from code changes.
Visual Asset Creation: Create high-quality presentation slides and carousels using Canva MCP.
Continuous Integration: Auto-generate and update release notes with every PR.
content.cta: What non-coding task should your agent automate? Let's discuss!

copy_notes: I connected the Canva MCP Server to my coding agent, created specialized LinkedIn Post Generation and Design Optimization skills, and used them to generate this content and its matching visual design.
